description: This file defines the RGraph.Gantt class, a JavaScript implementation for rendering Gantt charts using HTML5 Canvas. It includes methods for configuration, drawing, event handling, and animations specific to Gantt charts within the RGraph charting library.

classes.name: RGraph.Gantt
classes.description: Constructor for creating Gantt chart instances within the RGraph library, supporting configuration, drawing, interaction, and animation functionalities.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a property value; supports object style configuration.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the Gantt chart on the canvas.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a function in the context of the chart object, enabling method chaining.

methods.name: drawLabels
methods.description: Draws the top and side labels for the chart.

methods.name: drawEvents
methods.description: Draws the Gantt chart events and related elements.

methods.name: getShape
methods.description: Returns shape info if a shape (bar) is clicked or hovered.

methods.name: getBar
methods.description: Alias for getShape; retrieves bar shape info based on mouse event.

methods.name: drawSingleEvent
methods.description: Draws an individual event bar with optional labels and progress indicators.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights a shape (bar) on the chart.

methods.name: getObjectByXY
methods.description: Returns the chart object if the mouse is over the chart area.

methods.name: adjusting_mousemove
methods.description: Handles mouse move events for adjusting (moving/resizing) bars.

methods.name: positionTooltip
methods.description: Positions a tooltip element relative to a chart element.

methods.name: getXCoord
methods.description: Converts a data value to an X coordinate on the canvas.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets the data value corresponding to mouse position or event.

methods.name: parseColors
methods.description: Parses color strings, including gradients, for use in drawing.

methods.name: parseSingleColorForGradient
methods.description: Parses a color string and creates a gradient if specified.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Adds an event listener to the chart object.

methods.name: firstDrawFunc
methods.description: Function to run once after initial drawing.

methods.name: grow
methods.description: Animates the chart with a grow effect.

methods.name: resetColorsToOriginalValues
methods.description: Resets colors to their original values.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the chart to its initial state.
